items.title: Flattery and fanfare as Trump welcomed to China - but thorny issues remain
items.description: The leaders of the world's two superpowers were all smiles for the cameras during the US president's visit to Beijing.

items.title: 'Floating armoury' ship reportedly seized by Iran
items.description: A vessel said to be a “floating armoury” in the Gulf of Oman has been seized by Iranian military personnel, according to reports.

items.title: Cuba says CIA chief visited Havana as energy crisis worsens
items.description: The reported visit came after the US renewed an offer of aid to ease the effects of its oil blockade.

items.title: Ukraine rescuers pull dead from rubble of Kyiv flats after massive Russian strikes
items.description: Two children are among at least 16 killed in Ukraine's capital in massive Russian drone and missile attacks, officials say.

items.title: Giant new dinosaur identified from fossils in Thailand
items.description: The nagatitan is the largest dinosaur found in South-East Asia and weighs as much as nine elephants.

items.title: Latvian PM resigns after row over stray Ukrainian drones
items.description: Drones bound for Russia crashed down in Latvia last week, prompting a political fallout.

items.title: Warning of record global temperatures as chance of very strong El Niño grows
items.description: As El Niño develops this year, scientists are increasingly confident it could be one of the strongest on record with global consequences, as Simon King explains.

items.title: Five Italians die during cave dive in Maldives
items.description: Italy says the incident happened at a depth of 50m. Maldivian rescuers have so far found one body.

items.title: War criminal Ratko Mladić's jail release request denied
items.description: A UN judge admits the 84-year-old is "in the final stages of his life", but says prison conditions in The Hague ensure his maximum comfort.

items.title: 'Pretty miraculous' - 11 rescued after pilot ditches plane in Atlantic
items.description: The survivors spent about five hours on a life raft before being rescued by the US Air Force off Florida's coast.

items.title: Former Nigerian minister sentenced to 75 years in rare corruption verdict
items.description: Former Power Minister Saleh Mamman was convicted last week - but the authorities do not know his whereabouts.

items.title: 'They shot my neighbour in the head' - the lakeside city traumatised by war
items.description: Rebel fighters and Rwandan troops are accused of committing atrocities after capturing the DR Congo city of Uvira in December.
